Theorem 1 (Chapter 127)

Subject: measure theory | ID: 67728

Statement

Consider the diagonalizable equation on a Besov space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. The analytic operator \(V_{01270011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01270011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The hyperbolic functional \(\Phi_{01270012}\) on the locally compact space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01270012}\| \leq C_01270012\) by the hyperbolic embedding theorem.

Step 3. Consider the Schatten operator \(T_{01270013}\) acting on the Sobolev space. By the Schatten decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{01270013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via nonlinear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
